versions.changelog: Rewrite sprite setup guide: 6 clear steps. Explain that Gemini (Nano Banana) AI image gen is used for character+background fusion AND expression variants (not sharp overlay). Each step explains what tool is used and why.

Rewrite sprite setup as clear step-by-step guide: Step 1 (base character image) -> Step 2 (background) -> Step 3 (plan CSV) -> Step 4 (generate) -> Step 5 (verify). No more ambiguity for first-time users.

IMPORTANT: Sprites not included (ClawHub text-only). Add clear setup instructions for sprite preparation (Gemini gen or manual). Fix .clawignore -> .clawhubignore. Sync ASSETS_PLAN/manifest/CSV to actual 25 sprites. Production-ready for distribution.

Clean release: include all 25 sprites (compressed to 1080p). .env only reads skill-local (no parent dir walk). Remove all debug scripts and hardcoded IDs. Fish Audio TTS and Gemini image gen fully self-contained. No external skill dependencies.

Security fixes: remove debug scripts, hard-coded IDs and recipients. Fix .env to skill-local-first with upward walk. Internalize batch_generator (no external skill dependency). All external service refs now require explicit env vars.
Replace canvas with sharp (N-API, no ABI issues). Add comprehensive external dependency docs (Fish Audio, Nano Banana, Feishu). Clean up self-heal workarounds.
Docs update: Added setup guide, env template, and custom TTS instructions.
Slim release: Removed temp files and output videos.

Anima Avatar 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generates interactive 16:9 videos with dynamic Shutiao character sprites, synced audio, and text overlay.
- Integrates Fish Audio API for realistic voice synthesis and emotion-driven speech.
- Auto-selects from over 30 expression sprites for lifelike video output.
- Handles script editing, video composition (FFmpeg), and direct stream upload to Feishu with duration sync.
- Provides tools and workflow for customizing avatars, adding new sprites, and managing assets.
